name: Myconian Utopia Resort
positioning: Utopia Relais & Chateaux, a hillside resort above Elia Beach on the south coast of Mykonos, with sea-view rooms, suites and a villa with private pools or hot tubs
best_for: Couples wanting a sea-view suite with a private pool or hot tub above Elia Beach
Travelers who want a beach-and-pool base with yacht, helicopter and island yoga outings to Delos and Rhenia

facts.text: Utopia is on Elia Beach, on the south coast of Mykonos.
Elia Beach is the longest sandy beach on Mykonos and is known for its clear waters.
Guests have a dedicated area of Elia Beach with sunbeds, umbrellas, beach towels and a bar.
After dark, lighting makes the pool sparkle and the pool terrace becomes a nightlife spot.
Grand Majestic Retreat suites blend designer pieces with traditional craftsmanship and natural textures.
Heavenly Retreat rooms have rain showers, warm wood and carved stone accents, and a furnished balcony or a terrace with hot tub.
Signature Retreat rooms come with a furnished private balcony or a furnished terrace with private pool.
The spa offers massages, thalassotherapy rituals and facials.
Wellness options include yoga, Pilates, personal training and a gym.
Yacht day trips can sail to Delos for a private tour of its UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Helicopter tours fly over Mykonos toward Delos and out over Naxos, Paros and Tinos.
Pavilion is the hotel's Relais & Chateaux restaurant, serving creative Greek cuisine with sea views.

highlights.text: Utopia is perched on the hillside above the golden sands of Elia Beach.
The Grand Majestic Villa has a private terrace with an infinity pool, a hot tub and views of Elia Beach and the Aegean Sea.
Grand Majestic Retreat suites have free-standing deep soak tubs and private terraces with private pools or hot tubs and views of Elia Beach.
The pool terrace has an infinity pool with umbrella-shaded sunbeds and the Pool Club bar.
The hotel offers sunset yoga sessions on the uninhabited island of Rhenia and full-moon yoga and meditation on Delos.

considerations.text: Mykonos Town is about a 25-minute drive from Elia Beach.
Use of the dedicated Elia Beach area is arranged through reception and carries a charge, except for Grand Majestic Villa guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
